notes.title: Agarest: Generations of War Patch 17/03/2014
notes.content:
Thanks to our work on Agarest Zero we were able to track down and fix the audio glitch that was occurring on the main menu and during videos.  This bug was also fixed in Agarest Zero.

Thank you for your patience.
